description: Fetch the most-viewed Wikipedia articles by daily page views for a given language edition and time window. Returns a ranked list of article titles with view counts.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time window: yesterday (latest available day) / 7day (trailing 7 calendar days) / 30day (trailing 30 calendar days).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: MediaWiki language code for the Wikipedia edition (e.g. zh, en, ja, ko).
